responsibility: Implements the main AMD GCN target backend in C++, supplying most target hooks and backend-specific lowering outside the declarative .md files. It initializes per-function machine state, derives ISA and LDS resource policy from options, handles builtin setup and expansion, calling convention and register allocation rules, address and constant legality, prologue/epilogue and frame logic, vectorization preferences, OpenACC/OpenMP target hooks, assembly emission helpers, DWARF mappings, and finally binds all of these routines into TARGET_INITIALIZER for the GCN port.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C++ implementation file for the GCN port: unlike gcn.h it defines the target hook functions and binds them in TARGET_INITIALIZER, unlike gcn.md it provides procedural backend logic rather than RTL pattern descriptions, and unlike gcn.opt it consumes the generated option state instead of declaring command-line options.
